name: Teknoger Control
author: Yasin BOSTANCI

sections.description: Teknoger Control is a powerful plugin designed to customize and optimize the administrative features of your WordPress site. It offers features such as disabling admin notifications, unnecessary update alerts, and thumbnail uploads. By doing so, it helps make your WordPress site faster, cleaner, and more focused, enhancing the user experience. Teknoger Control WP simplifies site management, eliminates unnecessary alerts and notifications, and increases efficiency.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the teknoger-control folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).
  3. You will find the Contact menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes, Teknoger Control is completely free. You can use all its features without any charge.

What is the PHP version requirement?

PHP 7.4 or a higher version is required.

Which WordPress versions is it compatible with?

Teknoger Control is compatible with WordPress 6.7 and higher versions.

What is the Teknoger Control plugin?

Teknoger Control allows you to customize and optimize the administrative features of your WordPress site. It offers options like disabling admin notifications, updates, and thumbnail uploads to make your site faster and more organized.

How does the plugin affect your site’s speed?

Teknoger Control aims to improve your site’s speed by disabling unnecessary features. It enhances performance by preventing the loading of files like thumbnails and blocking unnecessary notifications.

Which features does the plugin disable?

The plugin allows you to disable admin notifications, updates, thumbnail uploads, and some other unnecessary features.

Can I receive plugin updates?

Yes, but if you activate the “Disable All WordPress Updates” feature, all WordPress updates, including those for this plugin, will be disabled. If this feature is not activated, you will continue to receive updates for the plugin.

Can I make a donation?

Yes, a donation link is available for those who want to support the plugin: https://teknoger.com.tr
